method: Visible packaged Electron app, real UI actions paced through Playwright. Single CDP start/stop, native timestamps, normal speed. Native file picker paths supplied automatically; Explorer reveal suppressed. Gold pointer overlay only. No scene injection, simulated output, cuts or removed waits.

steps.title: One asset. One continuous workflow.
steps.caption: Fusion Studio 0.19.0-rc.1 · fresh workspace · normal playback speed

steps.title: 01 / Import a DAZ asset
steps.caption: Open SPowered Trunk.duf and review conversion limits before importing.

steps.title: 02 / Inspect the editable scene
steps.caption: Frame the imported asset, orbit around it, then inspect its topology.

steps.title: 03 / Make a precise edit
steps.caption: Select the imported root and set its Y rotation to 25 degrees.

steps.title: 04 / Undo, then redo
steps.caption: Recover the original transform, then restore the edit through scene history.

steps.title: 05 / Save a project version
steps.caption: Name the project Trunk Study and save its editable scene.

steps.title: 06 / Reopen the saved project
steps.caption: Open the saved .fusion file; geometry and transforms restore from disk.

steps.title: 07 / Export a validated GLB
steps.caption: Create a new interchange file; inspect the actual glTF validation result.

steps.title: 08 / Light the scene
steps.caption: Add a three-point lighting rig and save the lit scene before rendering.

steps.title: 09 / Render the result
steps.caption: Cycles · OptiX · 1920 × 1080 · 32 samples. Render wait retained.

steps.title: Workflow complete.
steps.caption: Imported → inspected → edited → recovered → saved → reopened → exported → rendered.

checks: Transform changes scene hash; undo and redo exactly recover both scene states; geometry unchanged
Actual File > Open restores exact canonical geometry and scene digests through a newly deserialized scene
Real Cycles image returned by the packaged app
All source bytes and packaged ASAR unchanged
